_about: A demo scene for site/boardviz/scene.js. base: the board the frame is measured on (its part table in data/boardviz). boards: more boards placed by mating their sockets onto the base's headers (mate pairs, rot in degrees, lift in mm above the base). things: loose parts in the base board's millimeter frame (the USB cable end). steps: title, text, focus (a place that gets the label), and do: drop a board, show a thing, sound (a speaker's cone moves) or view (move the camera). Every step is one thing the reader does in the real build; the order is the recipe's order. The recipe's steps that need no board (hear the code on the computer, build, check the algorithms, build the apps image) are not drawn.
title: Audio BoosterPack on the LP-MSPM33C321A

things.label: USB cable
things.title: USB cable to your computer
things.text: One cable powers the LaunchPad, flashes it and carries its text output.

steps.title: Plug the pack onto the LaunchPad
steps.text: Press the BOOSTXL-AUDIO onto the LaunchPad kit's headers, speaker end toward the USB port. Leave jumper J5 on SPI DAC, the way it ships.

steps.title: Plug in USB and flash
steps.text: Connect the LaunchPad to your computer and flash the app. The program starts running when the flash ends.

steps.title: Play the tone
steps.text: Open the board's serial port at 115200 baud. Press a to switch the amplifier on, then 1 for a 1 kHz tone from the pack's speaker.

steps.title: Play the tune and listen back
steps.text: Press 2 for the four-voice tune, which loops. Press m to power the microphone, then c to capture what it hears. Keep the volume low so the microphone does not clip.
